notes: Mackie's official SRM550/SRM650/SRM750 specification sheet has a model-specific SRM550 column: frequency response 55 Hz–17 kHz at −3 dB (49 Hz–20 kHz at −10 dB), one 12-inch LF woofer and one 1.4-inch titanium HF compression driver, and a 2.6-inch LF voice coil. SRM550 is a powered loudspeaker. The system amplifier is rated 800 W RMS / 1600 W peak; only the explicitly stated 800 W RMS is entered as amplifier_output, not passive-speaker power handling. The sheet separately lists 132 dB maximum peak SPL, 90° × 50° nominal dispersion, and 3 kHz crossover; SPL is not sensitivity and nominal coverage is not imported as a polar dataset. No response points/directivity dataset are imported. Acoustic sensitivity, speaker-load impedance, resonant frequency, HF coil diameter, and any other unpublished fields remain N/A. Source: https://mackie.com/img/file_resources/SRM550_650_750_SS.pdf
